# Toast

> Transient notifications with a callable toast API and single Toaster mount.

This file matches the installed `toast` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/toast.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/toast.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- `lucide-react@^1.47.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `button`
- `core`
- `dialog`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/popup-knobs`: `popupKnobs`, types `PopupKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/toast`: `toastManager`, `toast`, `useToast`, `Toaster`, types `ToasterProps`

## Composition

### Application toast host

Mount one Toaster and call toast() from anywhere. An action button dismisses its toast after its handler runs; call event.preventDefault() in actionProps.onClick to keep it open. toast.loading stays until it is updated or dismissed.

```tsx
<Toaster />
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { Toaster, toast, toastManager } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/toast";

const PUBLISH_DURATION_MS = 2000;

function publishRelease() {
  const toastId = toast.loading("Publishing release", { description: "Uploading 12 assets." });
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    toastManager.update(toastId, { type: "success", title: "Release published", description: "Version 2.4.0 is live." });
  }, PUBLISH_DURATION_MS);
}

export function PrimitiveToastExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <Button variant="surface" onClick={() => toast("Changes saved", { description: "Your workspace is up to date." })}>
          Show toast
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" onClick={() => toast.success("Deployment live", { description: "Build 4f2a shipped." })}>
          Success
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" onClick={() => toast.error("Upload failed", { description: "The file exceeds the 25 MB limit." })}>
          Error
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="surface"
          onClick={() =>
            toast("Message archived", {
              actionProps: { children: "Undo", onClick: () => toast.success("Restored") },
            })
          }
        >
          With action
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" onClick={publishRelease}>
          Loading, then resolved
        </Button>
      </div>
      <Toaster />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `toast`
  - `content`: `data-behind`, `data-expanded`, `data-popup-kind` (`toast`)
  - `description`: `data-popup-kind` (`toast`), `data-type`
  - `indicator`: `data-popup-kind` (`toast`)
  - `root`: `data-ending-style`, `data-expanded`, `data-limited`, `data-popup-kind` (`toast`), `data-starting-style`, `data-swipe-direction` (`down` | `left` | `right` | `up`), `data-swiping`, `data-type`
  - `title`: `data-popup-kind` (`toast`), `data-type`
  - `viewport`: `data-expanded`, `data-popup-kind` (`toast`)
